findings.claim: FY2025 Section 301 關稅成本約 $7.375M（較 2024 的 $4.189M 增 76.1%），占營收約 1.8%，壓低毛利率；已申請 duty drawback，2025 回收 $907K；2025 年 7 月起加收 10% 關稅附加費。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025, Section 301 Tariffs totaled approximately $7,375,000, an increase of 76.1% compared to $4,189,000 incurred for 2024.

findings.claim: 2025 年對中國與香港出口約 $48.3M，占營收約 11.9%；產品屬 EAR99，不需出口許可。
findings.excerpt: our products are designated EAR99 commodities under the Export Administration Regulations of the U.S. Department of Commerce and are not subject to export licenses

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子指出美國持續擴大實體清單，出口管制規則與中美政府行動的影響不確定，可能對業務造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In recent years, the U.S. government has continued to expand the number of foreign entities on the Entity List (a restricted party list that imposes additional licensing requirements on shipments to listed parties).

note: 搜尋未找到 Vicor 專屬的 Section 232 或 2026 年新增出口管制資料；Section 232 半導體關稅（2026-01-14 公告）搜尋結果未與 Vicor 連結，不列為 finding。
